source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: While it leads an **[Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units)**, once each phase this model lets you set one [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) or [Damage](vsdata:core-rule/inflict-damage) result for one of that unit’s models to an unmodified 6.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
